title: Virtual Lab 5

stepCard.title: Step card
steps: Go to the shelf and take four mass bars.
At the balance, read the mass of the cart and of one bar.
At the track, load 2 bars on the cart. The mass is the cart plus the bars.
Set a fan setting and press Run.
Place the two markers far apart on the straight part of the speed graph. Read the acceleration.
Part 1: keep 2 bars. Run fan settings 1, 2, 3 and 4. Record each.
Predict, then Part 2: set the fan to 3 and run 0, 1, 2 and 4 bars. Record each.
Graph acceleration against fan force, then against mass.
Write your claim, evidence and reasoning. Use numbers from your tables.
afterCode2: Use your line to predict the acceleration with 3 bars. Then run it.

intro: Today you work in a lab, read your own data and write up what you find.
introSteps: Do the pre-lab: three pictures and one prediction. The lab door stays shut until you finish.
Huddle 1: Mr. D talks. He gives you the first code at the end.
Go through the door and follow the step card.
Huddle 2 comes late, after your data. Code 2 opens the last part of the lab.
keyRows: Open your notebook (it opens at the place the step card names).
Point at anything to see its name.
